# Almanac Design System

> React 19 + Tailwind 4 component kit (`@almanac/ui`, `packages/ui`) for Almanac's Supplier, Buyer and Platform portals: trade credit verification for UK food and beverage suppliers. Every visual decision is a semantic CSS variable. British English, sentence case, Lucide icons only, no emoji.

Agents: read the rules first, use tokens (never hex), compose from existing components, and mark anything new as a proposal.

## Rules
- [Kit rules (AGENTS.md)](packages/ui/AGENTS.md): copy, icon, table and card rules enforced in review
- [v2 design system rules](ai-ready/llms-full.txt#design-system-v2-rules): contrast, buttons, forms, recommended options
- [Domain nouns](docs/general/DOMAIN.md): Workspace, Organization, User; suppliers see buyers as Customers

## Tokens
- [Tokens, light (W3C DTCG 2025.10)](ai-ready/tokens/almanac.tokens.json)
- [Tokens, dark overrides](ai-ready/tokens/almanac.dark.tokens.json)
- [CSS source](packages/ui/src/styles/tokens.css): semantic variables; [Tailwind theme](packages/ui/src/styles/theme.css)

## Components
- [Registry (shadcn spec)](ai-ready/registry.json): 32 primitives, 40 compositions, theme
- [Primitives](packages/ui/src/components/): Button, Input, Textarea, Field, Label, Checkbox, Radio, Switch, Dropdown, Modal, Sheet, FocusPane, Tabs, ToggleGroup, Collapsible, Card, Badge, Text, Stack, Skeleton, Tooltip, Table, Pagination, Meter, RadialMeter, MetricCard, SparkBars, LineChart, BarChart, CountCircle, Markdown, NoStyleButton
- [Compositions](packages/ui/src/compositions/): PageHeader, PageNavbar, Empty, Restricted, OptionCard, ChoiceCard, CheckboxCard, SearchSelect, MultiSelect, PaymentMandate, CreditDecision, CreditBureauReport, CompanyInformation and more
- [Stories](packages/ui/src/components/): every component has a `*.stories.tsx` showing its variants
